Suvretta Capital Management Has Cut Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Stake by $144.34 Million; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Iconiq Capital Has Increased Position by $4.17 Million as Valuation Declined
May 5, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Iconiq Capital Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 424.16% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Iconiq Capital Llc bought 24,665 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund held 30,480 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $5.16 million, up from 5,815 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Iconiq Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $932.76 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.92% or $6.94 $183.83. About 53.48 million shares traded or 41.31% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% 7.94% the S&P500.
Aaron Cowen decreased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 45.88% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Suvretta Capital Management Llc sold 839,200 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Aaron Cowen held 989,740 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $170.66M, down from 1.83 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Suvretta Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $485.35 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.53% or $6.44 $188.89. About 57.79 million shares traded or 208.08% up from the average. Alibaba Group Holding Limited (NYSE:BABA) has risen 68.29% 56.74% the S&P500.

It also reduced its holding in Under Armour Inc by 38,000 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 344,839 shares, and cut its stake in Spdr Gold Trust (GLD).
